name: Xiamen Sunrise Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Sunrise Group Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research and development, production, and sale of steel products in China and internationally. The company offers car wheel products, such as tube steel wheels, tubeless steel wheels, and forged aluminum wheels for high-rise building, equipment support, pipe rack, and bridges areas. It is also involved in the design, manufacture, and installation of steel structures, as well as metal enclosure systems; petrochemical and equipment steel structure engineering, municipal administration and bridge and rail transit, large-scale high-end industrial plants, and high-rise steel structure buildings, and steel structure manufacturing of petroleum refining and chemical industries. The company was formerly known as Xiamen Sunrise Wheel Group Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Xiamen Sunrise Group Co., Ltd. in June 2015. Xiamen Sunrise Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Xiamen, China.
